gracelauncher.description: Grace Launcher is a highly customizable Android launcher inspired by Niagara Launcher, combining a clean, minimal home screen with plenty of room to make it your own. Keep your favorite apps within easy reach, browse an alphabetical app list, and personalize everything from individual icons and fonts to colors, clock designs, widgets, and shortcuts. It also brings useful features like calendar events, weather forecasts, notifications, and music controls to your home screen. With no ads, tracking, or internet permission, your launcher data stays on your device.
